The '''Carlix's Folly system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carlix's Folly]].
